result.summary: The restaurant carousel has a misaligned card, and some navigation and search text has low contrast.

issues.description: The inactive bottom navigation labels and search placeholder appear too light against their backgrounds, making them harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the text to meet contrast requirements, and ensure navigation icons also have sufficient contrast.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card sits lower than the neighboring cards in the 'Fastest near you' row.
issues.suggestion: Align the tops of the restaurant cards and their associated text consistently.
